meta.title: Suggested vendors are added as participants via "Invite Vendors"

steps.note: Start the event creation flow where suggested vendors can be invited.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Apply a pricing template before adding products.
Add a product whose mapped vendors should drive the suggested-vendor tip.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event is publishable.
Use the product's Invite Vendors action to add every suggested vendor mapped to the added product.
Publish the event so its Participants list can be inspected.
Verify the event was created successfully before checking participants.
Open the published stage's Participants list, the oracle for invited vendors.
Assert that the suggested-vendor invitation produced participants in the event audience.
